main_text.p: labefactare & prorsus tollere. Qui locus quantùm Pontificios torqueat, facilè ex eo cernitur, quòd, ut eludant Lectores, vertunt se in omnes facies, sed ità infeliciter, ut sibi invicem contradicant.

Primò¹Lib. 5. de Justif. c. 5. Bellarminus, omnia evadendi latibula inquirens, ait primò, Dictum esse, IN-UTILES SVMVS, de iis, qui extra gratiam operantur; ex Ambrosio. Maldonatus & Salmeron in eum locum, Dictum esse, aiunt, de iis servis qui non sponte & ex charitate operantur. Sic illi: quamvis Christus jam non nisi servos suos, viz. Apostolos, allocutus sit, qui tunc dixerunt ei, Auge nobis fidem: nempe eos, qui tunc præ cæteris in gratia constituti erant, &, reliquis omnibus, Christum ex charitate sequebantur. Atque semper debet Protasis cum Apodosi convenire.

Secundò ait Bellarminus, Dici INVTILES SERVOS, nempe Domino suo: sed tamen sibi utiles: ex Beda. Cui contradicit Maldonatus: Nam servus ille in Evangelio Domino utilitatem attulit: (Recte. Arabat enim, & armenta pascebat totâ die) Neque concludit Christus, DICITE, SERVI INVTILES SVMVS, quia nihil Deo utilitatis attulimus; sed quia QVOD DEBVIMVS FACERE FECIMVS. Sic ille: & in eandem sententiam Alphonsus de Castro, Tit. De Haresibus.

page.notes: Doubtful: the word "labefactare" and the phrase "in omnes facies" are heavier in the scan and may be italic or bold; italics are a best reading. The marginal reference mark before "Primò" is read as superscript 1 and is treated as note mark 1. Long s is plain s throughout. The right-hand strip belongs to the facing page and was left out. The last line "quia" is set at the right end of a full text line and is taken as running text.
